content:
# B"H
# YouTube Migration

Boruch Hashem. Blessed is He.

The Awtsmoos lets a creator carry chronology, descriptions, playlists, and source truth without counterfeit history;
Awtsmoos.com keeps IA-S3 keys local, sends video directly to the Archive shore, and publishes only after dry review.

## Choose the right path

Use `/youtube/` for the authenticated YouTube manager.
Use `/youtube/migrate/` for advanced creator-owned acquisition, Archive.org storage, dry planning, and explicit publication.
Use `/social/migrate/` for the unified Facebook/Instagram migration studio.

## Google Takeout

1. Open Google Takeout.
2. Deselect products you do not want.
3. Select **YouTube and YouTube Music**.
4. Choose the YouTube data you want.
5. Choose a one-time ZIP export.
6. Download every generated archive part.
7. Keep video beside `.info.json`, descriptions, thumbnails, subtitles/captions, and playlist metadata when available.
8. Open `/youtube/migrate/`.

Google Takeout help:
https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/3024190?hl=en

Google Takeout:
https://takeout.google.com/

## Download one owned video

YouTube Studio → Content → owned video menu → Download.

YouTube Studio download help:
https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/56100?hl=en

YouTube Studio:
https://studio.youtube.com/

## Advanced yt-dlp creator workflow

`/youtube/migrate/` can generate local `yt-dlp` commands for creator-owned material.
Review commands before running them.
Preserve info JSON, descriptions, thumbnails, subtitles/automatic captions, timestamps, and playlist evidence when useful.
Only migrate material you own or are authorized to migrate.

## Archive.org direct video storage

Video does not pass through Awtsmoos storage.

1. Get IA-S3 keys:
   https://archive.org/account/s3.php
2. Save them locally in the migration studio.
3. Session-only is the default; device persistence is explicit.
4. Choose local video files or an extracted downloaded folder.
5. The browser checks Archive.org upload capacity.
6. The browser PUTs video directly to `https://s3.us.archive.org`.
7. The successful result becomes a canonical `https://archive.org/download/...` URL.
8. Only that public URL/identifier/filename enters the Awtsmoos dry plan.
9. **Forget credentials** clears local credential storage.

IAS3 documentation:
https://archive.org/developers/ias3.html

Internet Archive notes that a successful PUT is staged/ingested and may queue derivation, so upload completion is not represented as instantaneous finished processing.

## Dry plan and explicit publish

The advanced studio performs:
local files → direct Archive.org storage → public-only checkpoint → YouTube migration dry plan → review → explicit unified publish.

Planning must not publish.
Archive upload must not publish.
Actual creation goes through `/api/social/unified-social/publish`.

The YouTube server guard accepts `archive.mediaUrl` only when it is a canonical Archive.org download URL and rejects credential-like fields.

## Playlist and chronology

YouTube playlists may map to Awtsmoos Series when source evidence proves the relationship.
A video may retain playlist provenance even when one canonical Series is selected.
Original known publication time is preserved.
Missing/invalid time remains **Unknown**, never January 1, 1970.

## Provenance

Source provenance may preserve YouTube video/channel identity, original URL, publication time, playlists, Archive.org public identifier/URLs, transcript languages, and migration time.
IA-S3 credentials are not provenance.

## Resumability

The YouTube checkpoint stores only public archive results and completed publication state.
It excludes `File` objects, object URLs, access keys, secret keys, and Authorization headers.
Retry only unfinished work; deterministic idempotency prevents duplicate publication.
